supersedes: 0.53.0; POST /communities/:communityId/join now resolves the spec 014 section 10.2 persona choice at the terminal membership commit. A join that commits an active membership must send persona (either an existing owned persona_id or the create_new choice); a request-mode join carries no persona because an intent never pre-binds identity. Successful terminal joins return the resolved persona_id; consumers must not invent one.
